title: Shared documentation update for recipe catalog architecture
description: Refresh architecture documentation to describe `RecipeCatalog` as the authoritative recipes data layer, its environment/lifecycle wiring, and the new relationship between list/detail consumers and in-memory parsed recipes.
acceptance_criteria: `docs/architecture.md` documents `RecipeCatalog` as the app-session source of truth for recipes.
Documentation removes or rewrites outdated explanations centered on `RecipeDiscovery` and per-open parsing in `RecipeDetailSheet`.
The docs reflect pull-to-refresh reload behavior and the parallel between recipe and aisle catalogs.
